original.target_description: Primary paper title and DOI verified. Single working-memory experiment. PDF page 4 (journal p. 1039) reports current distractor-interference effects, previous mnemonic-load effects, previous distractor-interference effects, and current-by-previous interactions, across accuracy and response time. The description and page locator do not identify one target test.

replication.target_description: Known locator/study mismatch: supplied study_r is 2, but PDF page 7 (journal p. 22) reports Experiment 1. This page contains Experiment 1 accuracy Table 2 and previous-trial accuracy models, with multiple load, interference, interaction and follow-up tests. No statistics from this different experiment are assigned to Experiment 2.

notes: Both full primary sources acquired. Page locators interpreted as PDF pages; neither supplied page number is a journal page number. Replication target_match=false records the definite Experiment 1 versus supplied Experiment 2 mismatch. Replication done denotes completed source inspection; all target statistics remain null because the located sample/test is not the supplied target. Experiment 2 results exist on PDF pages 10–12, but no unique test can be chosen from the neutral description. No effect was selected by audit-ID order. Authors give a general replication narrative, but an effect-specific narrative verdict cannot be matched without identifying the target test.
